title: Verify European indexed graphics contexts in the production CLI
changes: Record the production CLI create, reuse, verify and bounded ordinary-use checks for the e159 indexed graphics context resource.
validation: Windows GNU production build e159-indexed-context-cli-build-0cgxnfhb and Wine unit e159-indexed-context-cli-wine-27uqnksb passed. All 104 generated files matched the tested e159 dataset and remained unchanged during reuse and startup; the 11-frame world-map run reported four context bytes.
The Wine unit completed with a nonfatal D-Bus diagnostic and drained its server. The previously accepted interpreter pair remains the equivalence evidence for the bounded window.
limitations: Other ordinary contexts and consumers, full reader ABI, broader Wine regression filters, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
